notes: שֶׁ + שָׁם fused into the single pronominal adverb 'Whither' is retained: the one word carries both the relation and the resumption (rules 22, 30), headed on the relative; neither morpheme has a word of its own to split off.
The appositional 'even' is added: no object marker and no waw stands before שִׁבְטֵי־יָהּ (rules 14, 16).
Italic 'For' before עֵדוּת belongs to the bare adverbial nominal under rule 33; margins 'Jah' and 'a testimony' read and set aside.
